game_concept: A strategy race set in Snowy Hold – Ice Mill, a frozen mill wheel: the frost mage must handle frost imps while practicing functions. Core idea – Docstring Detective: Read docstrings to pick the right function for each case.
theme: Snowy Hold – Ice Mill: a frozen mill wheel
core_gameplay_loop: In Ice Mill, repeat each round: Read docstrings to pick the right function for each case. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the frost mage ahead. Then check the cases value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the wall banner by solving code steps involving cases that move the frost mage forward.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.5).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the wall banner first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 1 (intro tier): Docstring Detective
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Docstring Detective' (Week 6 slot 9), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Ice Mill'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold
region.mood: soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how cases changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against frost imps in Ice Mill.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.5).
